product.schneider-t486dx50.summary: The 50 MHz tower in Schneider’s 1992 range.
product.schneider-t486dx50.history: In November 1992, Computerwoche presented the T486DX50 at the top of Schneider’s new PC range. The December German price list listed the T 486DX/50 from DM 3,508 net without a hard disk.
product.schneider-t486dx50.technical.con: The sources describe different disk offerings. Computerwoche cites 245 MB and the December price list lists diskless, 211 MB and 340 MB versions.
product.schneider-t486dx50.technical.ver: The offer is documented. A dedicated model and boot validation in BluMach remain pending.
product.schneider-t486dx50.technical.lim: The board still needs to be checked against a specimen and an attributed BIOS preserved. An image with clear publication rights remains pending.
product.schneider-t486dx50.technical.sou: CC SELLER / BC, Schneider Computer, 12/1992, pp. 1–3
